Monthly depreciation is recommended for businesses calculating depreciation as part of a monthly close. It provides consistent full-month charges and commonly aligns with fixed-asset registers. Choose actual days if your documented accounting policy uses calendar-day proration. Confirm the company convention; the backward-compatible actual-day basis was used, not inferred from supplied depreciation.
